Reusable Agent Contexts
|-- AgentContext: validated conversation + pinned source evidence
|   |-- Capture a trajectory slice [agentContext.ts]
|   |   |-- Walk parent links from throughEntryId back to fromEntryId; reverse into order
|   |   |-- Reject duplicate IDs, cycles, missing entries and ranges spanning branches
|   |   `-- Require matching tool results before the next message or end of slice
|   |-- Snapshot = version + source identity + selected range + messages + contentHash
|   |   |-- Messages: user, assistant with optional tool calls, toolResult
|   |   |-- Content: text, source ranges, or one level of named sections
|   |   |-- Version: 1 = no source ranges/sections; 2 = source ranges; 3 = sections
|   |   `-- SHA-256 of canonical descriptor JSON; object keys sorted, array order retained
|   |-- Optional sourceFiles attachments
|   |   |-- Keyed by source-file hash; excluded from descriptor contentHash
|   |   `-- Validate attachment hashes, referenced use and attached range bounds
|   `-- Restore validates schema, hash and tool sequencing; snapshots returned as clones
|       `-- Raw context limit: 16 MiB
|-- Source capture and transport [fileAgentContextSources.ts]
|   |-- Input: registered sourceId + relative path + line range + optional revision
|   |   `-- Resolve through source registry; no caller-supplied absolute paths
|   |-- Capture chooses an exact backing version
|   |   |-- Explicit revision or bound Git revision -> resolve commit -> read Git blob
|   |   `-- Otherwise -> read current document bytes
|   |       |-- Git worktree bytes exactly match HEAD -> reference HEAD commit
|   |       `-- Otherwise -> immutable source snapshot addressed by content hash
|   |-- Git reads accept regular files only; reject trees, submodules and symlinks
|   |   `-- Cache up to 16 pinned file promises; failed reads can be retried
|   |-- persist(snapshot)
|   |   `-- Store attachments -> check distinct references -> return descriptor without attachments
|   |       `-- ImmutableRecords under agent-context-sources holds captured snapshots
|   `-- portable(snapshot)
|       `-- Load evidence -> retain only selected lines -> attach selected snapshots
|           `-- Rewrite ranges to snapshot hashes and recompute context contentHash
|-- Durable library [agentContextLibrary.ts + savedAgentContext.ts]
|   |-- create(name, context, requestId, optional description/group)
|   |   |-- Plain text -> one user message
|   |   |-- Constituents/sections -> capture source ranges -> one user message
|   |   |-- Existing snapshot -> validate as AgentContext
|   |   `-- Persist sources when adapter exists -> save as saved-agent-context-<UUID>
|   |       |-- Same requestId + same requestHash -> return existing record
|   |       `-- Same requestId + different requestHash -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|   |-- list(query, offset, limit)
|   |   `-- Search name/description -> newest first -> summaries + nextOffset
|   |-- read(id)
|   |   `-- Return compact snapshot and hash; separately return resolvedSnapshot when needed
|   |-- update(group) / addComment(text, expectedContentHash, requestId)
|   |   |-- Metadata changes leave model-visible snapshot and contentHash unchanged
|   |   `-- New comment requires current hash; records hash/time; identical retry adds no duplicate
|   |-- fork(parent, expectedContentHash, new name, requestId)
|   |   |-- Check parent hash -> copy pinned snapshot into a new saved ID
|   |   |-- Record lineage = parent ID + parent contentHash
|   |   |-- Inherit description/group unless overridden; comments stay on original
|   |   `-- Identical retry returns existing fork, including after later fork edits
|   `-- lineage(id)
|       `-- Walk ancestors -> return root-to-selected summaries + parentMatches
|           `-- Compare each pinned parent hash with current parent; missing/cyclic ancestry fails
|-- File-backed durability [fileAgentContextRepository.ts]
|   |-- <store>/agent-contexts/<saved ID>.json; global within store, independent of canvas/chat
|   |-- Read -> validate saved record, ID and AgentContext snapshot
|   |-- Create -> write/sync temporary file -> exclusive hard-link publish -> sync directory
|   |   `-- Existing ID is accepted only when requestHash matches
|   `-- Metadata update -> directory lock -> read/mutate -> write/sync -> atomic rename
|       `-- Wait up to 5 seconds for lock; clean up temporary file and lock on exit
|-- Model input reuse [agentContext.ts]
|   |-- resolveSources(): attached snapshot first, otherwise supplied source reader
|   |   |-- Repeated identical ranges share a read within the resolution call
|   |   |-- Replace ranges with text while retaining sections and tool calls
|   |   `-- Bound expanded source text to 16 MiB; produce a newly hashed context
|   |-- toPiMessages(): emit section boundary labels and imported-history provenance
|   |   |-- Unresolved source ranges -> error
|   |   `-- Synthetic assistant metadata does not select the run's model
|   `-- Reusable history can seed independent sessions; library reads launch no model
`-- Diagram-bound reuse [diagramAgentContext.ts]
    |-- compileDiagramAgentContext(diagram)
    |   |-- Capture original evidence lines as hashed source attachments + range references
    |   |-- Build a diagram-context user message with binding/evidence metadata
    |   `-- Retain diagramId, compiledFromRevisionId and sourceFingerprint
    |       `-- Fingerprint hashes binding + evidence, providing a key for detecting evidence changes
    |-- Captured evidence is background; current diagram supplied on each edit is authoritative
    |-- Storage forms
    |   |-- Inline snapshot: supported for older workspaces and portable exports
    |   `-- Stored reference: backingRecordId + contentHash; diagram carries a small reference
    `-- Load -> retrieve backing snapshot -> validate hash, agent type and diagram identity
        `-- Unavailable backing storage or mismatched diagram context -> explicit error
